title: Streptavidin-CBD Purification
author: Manuela De Las Casas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6e8hbhw

steps.title: Inoculate Bacteria
steps.instruction: Resuspend a few bacterial colonies from Petri dishes in liquid LB in an Erlenmeyer flask using a Digralsky planting handle.

substeps.instruction: Set up more than one flask to minimize risk.
Grow a negative control using bacteria without the plasmid.

steps.title: Grow Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the bacteria at 37ºC until the OD600 reaches approximately 0.6 (range 0.4-0.8), ensuring the culture is in the log phase.

substeps.instruction: Periodically check OD using an ultrospec, using a blank cuvette with LB for comparison.
Discard the volume pipetted into cuvettes after measurement; do not return it to the flask.

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Collect and lyse the bacterial cells to purify the protein.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 3-5 min at 15000 x g.
Resuspend the cell pellet with B-mercaptoethanol and SDS.

steps.title: Verify Protein Expression (Optional)
steps.instruction: Perform a quality check to verify the presence of the desired protein via electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge again for 3-5 min at 15000 x g.
Run an electrophoresis using 1:10 and 1:100 dilutions from the supernatant in an SDS-page acrylamide gel (pore size 10-12%).
